mapper.select: SELECT edge_device_id FROM tb_edge_device WHERE device_nm = #{deviceName} AND enabled = TRUE ORDER BY edge_device_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_edge_device SET last_seen_at = NOW(), upd_dt = NOW() WHERE edge_device_id = #{edgeDeviceId}
mapper.select: SELECT camera_id, location_id FROM tb_camera WHERE edge_device_id = #{edgeDeviceId} AND source_ref = #{sourceRef} AND enabled = TRUE
SELECT model_bundle_id, pose_model_sha256, fall_model_sha256 FROM tb_model_bundle WHERE bundle_nm = #{bundleName}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_model_bundle ( bundle_nm, pose_model_nm, pose_model_sha256, fall_model_nm, fall_model_sha256, feature_ver, model_config ) VALUES ( #{bundleName}, #{poseModelName}, #{poseModelSha256}, #{fallModelName}, #{fallModelSha256}, #{featureVersion}, CAST(#{modelConfigJson} AS JSONB) )
mapper.select: SELECT c.config_ver FROM tb_camera_config c WHERE c.camera_id = #{cameraId} AND c.config_ver = ( SELECT MAX(config_ver) FROM tb_camera_config WHERE camera_id = #{cameraId} ) AND c.capture_config = CAST(#{captureConfigJson} AS JSONB) AND c.bed_roi IS NOT DISTINCT FROM CAST(#{bedRoiJson} AS JSONB) AND c.bed_exit_config IS NOT DISTINCT FROM CAST(#{bedExitConfigJson} AS JSONB)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_camera_config ( camera_id, config_ver, capture_config, bed_roi, bed_exit_config ) VALUES ( #{cameraId}, #{configVer}, CAST(#{captureConfigJson} AS JSONB), CAST(#{bedRoiJson} AS JSONB), CAST(#{bedExitConfigJson} AS JSONB) )

INSERT INTO tb_camera_session ( camera_session_id, camera_id, model_bundle_id, config_ver, started_at ) VALUES ( CAST(#{cameraSessionId} AS UUID), #{cameraId}, #{modelBundleId}, #{configVer}, #{startedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (camera_session_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT s.camera_id, c.location_id FROM tb_camera_session s JOIN tb_camera c ON c.camera_id = s.camera_id WHERE s.camera_session_id = CAST(#{cameraSessionId} AS UUID)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_detection_event ( event_id, camera_id, camera_session_id, location_id, track_id, event_type, decision_st, event_at, decision_score, event_detail ) VALUES ( CAST(#{eventId} AS UUID), #{cameraId}, CAST(#{cameraSessionId} AS UUID), #{locationId}, #{trackId}, #{eventType}, #{decisionSt}, #{eventAt}, #{decisionScore}, CAST(#{eventDetailJson} AS JSONB) ) ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(e.event_id AS VARCHAR) AS event_id, e.event_type, e.decision_st, e.event_at, w.hosp_div_id AS hospital_id, w.ward_id, w.ward_nm AS ward_name, l.location_nm AS location_name, l.location_type, e.event_detail ->> 'duplicate_of' AS duplicate_of FROM tb_detection_event e JOIN tb_location l ON l.location_id = e.location_id JOIN tb_ward w ON w.ward_id = l.ward_id WHERE e.event_id = CAST(#{eventId} AS UUID)
